automatedSuites.name: notifications
automatedSuites.output: Notifications passed: warm-up and auction deadline windows, per-human deduplication, training completion, all preference opt-outs, five-language payload selection, deep-link IDs, concurrent worker claims, retry lease, expired events, category collapse, and invalid-token removal. APNs transport was simulated; no real notification was sent.

automatedSuites.name: client-commands
automatedSuites.output: Client command recovery passed: identical request IDs after network/500 uncertainty, new IDs after confirmed success or definitive rejection, and authenticated 304 clock recovery.

automatedSuites.name: production
automatedSuites.output: Production adapter contract passed: shared transaction lock, bound parameters, commit/rollback, client release, private-host validation, proxy headers, beta/production environment isolation and fail-closed startup without managed storage. No managed runtime connection or public deployment is claimed by this test.

automatedSuites.name: onboarding
automatedSuites.output: Onboarding passed: real HTTP registration/recovery/logout; recovery rotation and session revocation; public/private isolation; 10 concurrent public joins; 90-second bot start; rename; Apple JWT signatures, nonce, expiry, code exchange, replay, encrypted tokens, reauthentication, deletion and revocation retry. Apple network calls used a local fake transport, not real credentials.

automatedSuites.name: state-sync
automatedSuites.output: State sync passed: authenticated 304 responses, no response body on unchanged snapshots, account/league isolation, auto-start deadlines, wallet triggers, bid invalidation, unchanged-wallet write avoidance, and hourly rollover. Thirty idle polls required metadata only.

automatedSuites.name: online
automatedSuites.output: Online passed: 10-agent/2-client limits and permanent third slot for exactly 250 diamonds, insufficient balance and duplicate debit protection, escrow/concurrent bids, atomic replacement, club exclusivity and voluntary agency offers, 28 nights (876 league + 165 European matches), 15 weekly newcomers, restart safety, privacy, real HTTP auth, command deduplication, chat/block/report/rate limits, signed commerce boundary, SSV signature and duplicate reward, season reset preserves gems, logout invalidates session.

automatedSuites.name: online-only
automatedSuites.output: Online-only passed: direct entry ignores old solo preference; login/settings/error recovery in five languages; inherited sessions removed on logout without erasing historical saves or another account. The production build separately verifies its module graph.

automatedSuites.name: ads
automatedSuites.output: Ads: incomplete/wrong IDs and web blocked, consent before SDK, no reward on dismissal/zero/failure, one delivery, concurrent show blocked, listeners cleaned and privacy action passed. Native ads were not requested.

automatedSuites.name: boot
automatedSuites.output: Boot scripts parse; recovery preserves existing account, purchase and historical save storage.

automatedSuites.name: online-player-mechanics
automatedSuites.output: Player mechanics passed: stable profile migration and six role-specific skills; physical traits and scouting privacy; actual match XP and rating impact; potential ceiling; validated sale prices and no minted coins; listing update/withdraw/expiry; reserved-client protection; confirmed release to one shared auction; unchanged identity; final-week placements settle before the last match and server strategy scores match previews; season deadline migration; authenticated HTTP trade, concurrent release/duplicate-request safety and account deletion cleanup.

automatedSuites.name: jsx-bindings
automatedSuites.output: JSX component bindings passed: 87 files.

automatedSuites.name: online-pass
automatedSuites.output: Season pass passed: exact 28-tier rewards, 5-language-ready DTOs, Paris/DST missions, real action XP, duplicate claims and signed receipt boundary, Premium/Plus, escrow-safe refunds and reversal, late purchase credit, day-20 skips, badge/sticker ownership, final reward window, season reset and legacy rights.

automatedSuites.name: rankings
automatedSuites.output: Ranking passed: durable cumulative season points, rank scale, exactly-once attribution, bots/short/overlapping seasons excluded, global/country/region filters, private profile, safe query inputs, country cooldown, history, career summary and cycle reward deduplication.

automatedSuites.name: career-extras
automatedSuites.output: Career extras passed: permanent server-earned Game Center IDs, tutorial without economic rewards, visible owned cosmetics, finished-season departure preserving career/gems, no repeated departure, public league visibility retained on reset.

automatedSuites.name: backup
automatedSuites.output: Backup passed: atomic export/restore of all 16 game tables, account/wallet and career points preserved, foreign keys, occupied database and unknown schema rejected.

automatedSuites.name: store-ui
automatedSuites.output: Store UI passed: beta blocks real-money packs/pass while earned free rewards and the 250-gem third slot remain usable.

automatedSuites.name: online-locales
automatedSuites.output: Online localization passed: 647 explicit messages in five languages, placeholders, dynamic reward/sticker/mission keys and Home/Market/Profile/Player/Chat/Pass/BadgeEditor React renders.

automatedSuites.name: client-resilience
automatedSuites.output: Client resilience passed: 90s cold / 15s warm deadlines, visible slow-network state, overlap cleanup, no automatic write replay, ranking refresh only when visible and foreground event throttling. Timers and transport are simulated.

automatedSuites.name: ledger-ui
automatedSuites.output: Ledger UI passed: server-owned balance 53, reserved bid 20, available 33, settled income/expense only, rival privacy, no state mutation, five languages and empty/no-league states.
